verification_report.summary: The supplied smooth mixed-form identity and its uniqueness consequence are correct, as is the compact Gauduchon surface corollary with a common additive-constant-fixing normalization. The stated dc/ddc conventions give a real semipositive dw wedge dcw and the positive Stokes sign with factor 1/2. Dense positivity and continuity justify global vanishing of dw. Higher-dimensional Gauduchon alone does not imply ddcT=0; the draft correctly limits its claim. All sequential and reference checks passed. The full readable audit is saved alongside this file as verification_report.md.
